channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO valuation talk is reported to cool to $1.5 trillion
item.description: Prospective backers are said to have discussed a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's November listing, down from about $2 trillion.

item.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable opens for preorders
item.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone is now available to preorder, starting at $1,999 and reaching $3,199 for 2TB.

item.title: Street Fighter opens with $4 million in previews despite weak reviews
item.description: Paramount's live-action Street Fighter took $4 million in Thursday previews, with critics cool and audiences warmer.

item.title: Rockstar releases GTA VI's final trailer ahead of its November 19 launch
item.description: The last trailer before launch focuses on Jason and Lucia, set to a strong soundtrack, five weeks before release.

item.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a huge open-weight model that runs on two Macs
item.description: Meta's 816-billion-parameter Muse Spark Open model is built for coding and agents and can run on two Mac Studio machines.

item.title: Sega pulls the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster after an 'Overwhelmingly Negative' launch
item.description: Sega is temporarily removing the remaster from sale and restoring the original game after players reported bugs and possible AI-upscaled art.

item.title: Apple launches HomeView, a $300 smart display, with a wider smart home lineup
item.description: Apple opened preorders for a 7-inch HomeView display, a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K and cameras, locks and thermostats.

item.title: Marvel's VisionQuest lands on Disney+ with a 79% critics score
item.description: The eight-episode series follows a rebooted Vision on the run, and critics call it clever but loosely tied to the wider MCU.

item.title: Bank of America brought in 1,000 contractors to fix flaws found by Claude Mythos
item.description: The bank hired outside contractors to patch weaknesses that advanced AI models, including Anthropic's Mythos, exposed in its software.

item.title: House House keeps Big Walk off Xbox, citing the BDS boycott of Microsoft
item.description: The Untitled Goose Game studio says its next game will not come to Xbox while Microsoft remains a BDS boycott target.

item.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT's risks to minors
item.description: Eight states filed separate lawsuits saying OpenAI misled consumers about ChatGPT's risks and did not do enough to protect children.

item.title: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes film takes $1.75 million in previews
item.description: A24's three-hour You Can See Everything opened in theaters after glowing reviews and a solid preview night.

item.title: Bloomberg report details why GTA VI took almost eight years
item.description: Rockstar's staff nearly doubled since 2018, and executives say future games will come faster on the tools built for GTA VI.

item.title: OpenAI is reported to triple ChatGPT advertisers to about 60,000
item.description: OpenAI's ad business reportedly reached around 60,000 advertisers as it cut prices, while a test showed how precisely ads can be targeted.

item.title: Researchers say an ad network was used to plant Candiru spyware on journalists' phones
item.description: Citizen Lab says malicious ads bought through Discover-Tech infected at least 45 devices of Al Jazeera journalists without a click.

item.title: Peacock's Friday the 13th prequel Crystal Lake is this weekend's horror pick
item.description: The series is set a year after young Jason drowns, as the town starts asking questions about Pam Voorhees.

item.title: Epic tests a new launcher it says was built entirely with AI
item.description: Epic's rebuilt Epic Games Launcher is in testing and, the company claims, boots faster than Steam.

item.title: Amazon launches Bee AI wearables that listen to and summarize conversations
item.description: The $75 Bee Frontier bracelet and $100 Bee Eclipse phone attachment turn conversations into summaries and to-do lists.

item.title: FTC sends OpenAI and Anthropic 50-page demands for safety records
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission issued long civil investigative demands to both labs over AI safety incidents.

item.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia would cut off customers building unsafe AI
item.description: Nvidia's CEO said it would stop supplying chips to customers who build unsafe AI, and pledged $250 million of compute for UK safety research.

item.title: Microsoft finishes pre-training MAI-Base-2, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model
item.description: Microsoft AI says its new base model beat every open-weight model in private tests while using less compute than a DeepSeek rival.

item.title: Ubisoft proposes closing Trials studio RedLynx and cuts 70 roles in Singapore
item.description: The latest round of Ubisoft's restructuring could close the Finnish studio and trims the Skull and Bones team.

item.title: Dutch consumer groups sue Meta over its camera smart glasses
item.description: Consumentenbond and two advocacy groups want Meta to change the glasses and stop processing data unlawfully for AI.

item.title: Stranger Than Heaven trailer shows Snoop Dogg teaching the hero to rap
item.description: The Like a Dragon studio's new game gets a story trailer starring Snoop Dogg, ahead of a January launch.

item.title: Cyberattack disrupts Albert Heijn as Dutch police urge Ahold Delhaize to report it
item.description: Dutch authorities publicly asked the supermarket group to file a criminal complaint after a cyberattack hit its logistics.

item.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy star in Netflix's hostage comedy Sacrifice
item.description: Netflix's new film follows a movie star taken hostage at a charity gala by a doomsday cult.

item.title: White House AI task force adopts its charter and starts a 120-day clock
item.description: The new Super Intelligence task force has 120 days to deliver a report on cyber, biosecurity and model accountability risks.

item.title: Oasis reunion tour documentary arrives on Disney+
item.description: Don't Look Back in Anger follows the Gallagher brothers' Oasis Live '25 tour and the fans who went.

item.title: Remedy's Control Resonant sells one million copies in three weeks
item.description: Remedy says the Control sequel is its fastest-selling game.

item.title: Apple's trade secret case against OpenAI reaches its first major hearing
item.description: Apple accuses OpenAI of using confidential information for its upcoming hardware, and OpenAI has agreed not to use the disputed files for now.

item.title: Safari beta hints at Apple's first touchscreen MacBook ahead of a reported event
item.description: New interface elements in Safari suggest macOS 27 is being readied for touch, as Apple is reported to plan a late-October showcase.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out after strong reviews
item.description: Konami's new 2.5D Castlevania, set in a Paris ruled by Dracula, launched on October 15.

item.title: Taiwan to fund a Texas industrial park of up to $4 billion for Nvidia's suppliers
item.description: Taiwan plans US industrial parks for the smaller firms that supply Nvidia, TSMC and Foxconn, starting in Texas.

item.title: OpenAI and Meta warn US judges that deepfakes may outpace detection
item.description: The two companies told a federal judicial panel that reliably spotting AI-generated evidence may not be possible.

item.title: Netflix releases an archive-only Norm Macdonald documentary
item.description: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald tells the comedian's story entirely through archive footage, photos and home videos.

item.title: Tulsa King season 4 premieres on Paramount+
item.description: Sylvester Stallone's mob drama returns as Dwight pushes his crew toward legitimate business.

item.title: Six tech giants gave a combined $92 million toward the White House ballroom
item.description: Nvidia, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta together contributed $92 million to President Trump's ballroom project.

item.title: Nscale's planned $35 billion IPO is shaken by a Norway data center delay
item.description: Bloomberg reports the AI cloud firm's flagship Norway site is six months behind schedule as it prepares a New York listing.

item.title: Whalefall opens quietly with $990,000 in previews
item.description: The survival thriller about a diver swallowed by a whale took under a million dollars on its preview night.

item.title: KATSEYE's Wild Hearts documentary lands on Disney+
item.description: The film charts the girl group's rise from a talent competition to global pop stardom, with unseen footage.

item.title: Fontaines D.C. release new album Dopamine Chamber
item.description: The Irish band's new record on XL Recordings tops NPR's New Music Friday picks for the week.

item.title: Indie hit Peak climbs onto consoles this month
item.description: The co-op climbing game arrives on consoles with all the updates released on PC so far.

item.title: Cohere plans to buy AI security startup AISLE
item.description: Cohere signed a letter of intent to acquire AISLE, whose AI scanner found 18 of 24 recent flaws in cURL.
